text:
Priya (Marketing): quick sync: need social assets for our "Serving LLMs at Scale" webinar next Wed. Deliverables: three LinkedIn posts (tease, live reminder, replay), a 6-tweet X thread, a 30s highlight clip + thumbnail, and two hero images (16:9 + square). Also want UTM conventions and an original_channel param so RevOps can route leads. Who's free to take what?

Dan (Social): I can own scheduling + X thread. Need final copy by Tue morning to queue. Any preferred cadence for the thread?

Priya (Marketing): thread cadence: set tweets to post every 2 mins so first engagement window is condensed. CTA on last tweet to RSVP.

Sam (Design): I'll take hero images and thumbnail. Need copy stings and brand lockups by EOD Mon. Preferred file outputs?

Ivy (Content): Drafts incoming. Two headline variants for LinkedIn A/B test, concise captions for the clip, and the X thread in bullet form.

Ivy (Content): LinkedIn A: "Inside our production inference stack: how we keep latency predictable and costs down. Join our engineers on Feb 10."

Ivy (Content): LinkedIn B: "Ship LLM features faster: practical ops & routing strategies from our infra team. Register for Feb 10."

Ivy (Content): X thread (6 tweets):
1/ Production LLMs need operational thinking. We built a runtime prioritizing latency SLOs.
2/ Continuous batching + adaptive kernels reduced per-token CPU by ~30% in tests.
3/ Prefix/KV caching cut repeat token generation across sessions.
4/ Multi-tier routing & graceful fallbacks avoided regional outages during spikes.
5/ We'll show demos and numbers on Feb 10  RSVP: [link with utm]
6/ TL;DR: practical tips you can copy into your stack.

Ivy (Content): UTM scheme: utm_source=social&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=serving_llms_webinar&utm_content={variant}
Also add param original_channel={channel}. Noah, can RevOps map that through?

Noah (RevOps): yes. We'll map utm_campaign=serving_llms_webinar. For original_channel param, ensure it's in the signup form; I'll set up automation to tag leads. Also need final field list by Tue EOD to wire webhooks.

Priya (Marketing): good. Sam, thumbnail dimensions: 1280x720 for clip, 1200x1200 for square. Add Redwood footer and "Register" badge on hero.

Sam (Design): noted. Will post comps to #marketing-assets by Mon night.

Kai (Growth): suggestion: include a 2nd tweet in thread summarizing a concrete number to boost shareability. Also let's pin the thread for 12 hours after publishing. Budget $800 for post-webinar boost if a headline wins.

SchedulerBot: Task created: "Queue social posts for Serving LLMs webinar"  schedule dates: teaser Mon 09:00 PT, day-of Tue 09:15 PT, X thread Tue 09:30 PT, replay Wed 10:00 PT. Link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/serve-llms

Priya (Marketing): action list:
- Ivy: finalize copy + add original_channel param examples (due Tue noon)
- Sam: hero images + thumbnail comps (due Mon EOD)
- Dan: schedule X thread + pin (queue Tue)
- Noah: wire UTMs & webhook mapping (need final form fields Tue EOD)
- Kai: prepare paid boost plan (hold until post-replay metrics)

Priya (Marketing): drop final assets and copy in #marketing-assets. Thanks all :sparkles:
